title: How to Build a Knowledge Base
summary: How to build a knowledge base for your team or customers — step-by-step guide using AI. Covers search, permissions, categories, and deployment in hours.
body_markdown: Yes. Export your existing content as markdown or HTML from either tool, then import it into your Blink knowledge base. You'll need to review category assignments and permissions — Confluence's space/page hierarchy and Notion's database structure both map reasonably to a category/article model. Most teams find the migration cleaner than expected because it forces a content audit: you only move what's actually useful.
